description:
Implement search functionality in the Employee Directory app.

The app currently displays a list of employees in a RecyclerView. Your task is to:

1. Add a Search Item to the App Bar:
   - Create/Modify `res/menu/main_menu.xml`.
   - Add an item with ID `action_search`.
   - Use `androidx.appcompat.widget.SearchView` as the action view.
   - Configure it to show as an action (`ifRoom`).

2. Update `EmployeeAdapter.kt`:
   - It currently displays a static list.
   - Implement filtering logic so that the RecyclerView only shows employees whose names contain the search query (case-insensitive).
   - You will likely need to maintain a separate list for the filtered results vs the original full data.

3. Connect it in `MainActivity.kt`:
   - Override `onCreateOptionsMenu` to inflate the menu.
   - Set an `OnQueryTextListener` on the SearchView.
   - Pass the query text to your adapter's filtering method when the text changes.

Goal: Typing in the search bar should filter the list in real-time.
